new_fused_findings.finding: The synthetic semantic-transaction-isolation result now has a concrete Frank-reference repository analogue: current status rendering reads UnifiedDB state and the v0.1 milestone source separately without one shared semantic snapshot epoch/hash, so a mixed status state is an OPEN repository-evidence-supported failure mode.

TurnTraceEnvelope and atomic StatusSnapshot should become the replay/status manifestation of the same invariant-boundary principle: authoritative user-visible state and consequential effects must bind to coherent semantic epoch/root hashes, environment/build identity and explicit failure/repair receipts.

The admitted ClayCode G9 V3 source currently contains relational/control constructs the admitted EBNF cannot express (> , >= , if). This is a concrete BASE-stage self-conformance gap; the tested subset indicates a minimal grammar/control repair is sufficient and does not justify broad semantic redesign.

The integrated highest-information near-term test becomes: atomic StatusSnapshot + TurnTraceEnvelope + bounded recurrence under concurrent state mutation, with fail-closed root verification and provenance-aware external effect closure, replayed in deterministic and outside-in lanes.
